title: Elitea Runtime Application Version V1
description: The private claim-bound HTTP response for one saved application version.

frozen_definition_sha256.description: Main's opaque digest of the exact frozen pre-redemption definition. Omission preserves the legacy response. Null is invalid.

data_classes.description: The application's declared data classes from its agent registry row (ADR-0044 decision 3). The worker narrows a delegation to them. Omitted when it declares none. Declared metadata, not classifier output.
